description: S6. Isochron Scepter with Dramatic Reversal imprinted, Sol Ring, Arcane Signet and Fellwar Stone, and Walking Ballista, on tymna_thrasios's turn (pod n7WpsqsZtdQ). The loop: rocks make 4, Scepter costs 2 to cast a free Reversal that untaps every nonland permanent, net 2 per pass; the mana goes into Ballista counters and pings. Tests an activation loop with an X outlet (Isochron Scepter carries AI:RemoveDeck:All). Success: tymna_thrasios wins on the scenario turn.
notes: Deviation: no allowed study deck lists Isochron Scepter (the holdout pods are off-limits), and none lists Walking Ballista beside Dramatic Reversal. tymna_thrasios lists Dramatic Reversal and the rocks; the harness places Scepter and Ballista (the writer warns), and the plan arm's plan data knows neither.
The imprint is seeded with Forge's own Imprinting / ExiledWith options, the pair Forge writes when it saves a board with an imprinted Scepter.
Opponents hold no instant-speed interaction; every seat at 40 life.
